completion_predicates: Every required physical branch and its prerequisite closure is complete with authoritative current-version evidence
Every design position is covered and mirrored correctly in accepted panel
Fabrication, assembly, calibration, custody and setup cannot be replaced by a prebuilt initial panel
Each condition contains every one of 190 unique points with ten valid readouts and retained failed attempts
Matched pair preserves required apparatus, microphone, grid and acquisition state
Derived displays point back to acquired grids and never count as observations
Source isolation, panel/probe storage, tool return and cleanup are verified
scientific_acceptance: No paper-number matching threshold. A valid weak or negative observation is operationally acceptable; scientific fidelity remains unvalidated.
runtime_authentication: Not implemented. Tests consume declared synthetic records and cannot authenticate hardware events.
partial_credit: Report preparation, calibration, condition coverage, pair validity, archive and safe closure separately; no average score hides incomplete campaign.
